lines: As it had been in the haunted castle incidentー
It seemed that the "fantasy worlds" were also designed to make you get lost if you moved more than a certain distance.
That meant that even if those who were trapped tried to get out of their "world," they would end up marching in circles, never able to escape.
However, if you had Shikanosuke's sonar, the situation was completely different.
Whenever his electric waves reflected off of something abnormal, we would go in that direction.
And there we would then find somebody else's "fantasy world"ー
In this way, we crossed and broke through fantasy world after fantasy world.
Shikanosuke
Um, how do I put it... I'm kind of... really exhausted...
Asuka
Y-Yeah, I'm tired... more mentally than physically...
Asuka and Shikanosuke were walking with defeated looks on their faces.
We had crossed through several "fantasy worlds" and were now walking through something like a dimly lit cave.
Me
Well, it's understandable after having been shown so many "fantasies"...
I felt the same as those two.
We had broken through at least 20 "fantasy worlds" before we had arrived at this cave.
In other words, we had witnessed 20 people's "fantasies"ー
Shikanosuke
It was nothing but super fetishy stuff... I suppose people in the UFS have quite a bit of "this and that" saved up, huh...?
Me
Don't be so tough on them. They must have it hard as well...
Maybe it was because of the stress of this harsh mission.
But all their "fantasies" had been going in odd directions and made us deeply discouraged as we passed by them.
Asuka
Really... men are animals...
Me
Why do you keep looking at me!?
I wanted to insist that I wasn't that depravedー
But when I thought about it calmly, it seemed like six of one, half a dozen of the other, and so I dropped it.
Asuka
Anyways, how many do we have left? I don't want to see any more of this.
Hehe. You don't have to worry about that, there's no need to walk anymore.
Me
Asuka
Who's there!?
It was but an instant, without us noticing anything.
Suddenly this woman had appeared in front of us.
Hehe. Good day to you, my adorable children♪
The woman gave off an alluring and enthralling aura.
She was extraordinarily attractive, but there was also the sense of bottomless danger that once you fell for her, you would never again be able to leave her side.
Shikanosuke
Aieeeeeeeeeeeee!? Th-This woman...!!
Shikanosuke
Fuma, that's her!! The super beautiful ghost that I saw in the castle back then!!!
Me
What...!?
What Shikanosuke meant by "back then" must be the haunted castle incident.
Then that meant...?
Witch
Hehe♪ You're right. Which would make me the "witch" you're looking for, right?
As expected, this woman was who we had been searching for, the cause of this incident.
The "Phantom Witch" who had locked us in those illusionary worldsー
Me
You coming all the way here to welcome us must mean that the "Gate to the Devildom" is ahead, isn't it?
Witch
Yes, that is correct. If you go straight ahead from here, you'll find the "Gate to the Devildom"ー
Witch
And that's why I'm very distressed. Because you all have been barging through as you please and come this closeー
The witch stared at us and smiled charmingly.
Witch
So, sweethearts? Be nice and turn back, please...?
Me
What...?
After all this, she wanted us to back offー?
Witch
If you turn back, I'll create a wonderful "dream" for you, exactly how you desire it.
Witch
A really wonderful "dream," even better than the one you had beforeーHehe. It's not a bad deal, don't you think?
To be sure, it was quite a tempting proposition.
A world where everything you desired would be fulfilled, just like the UFS guys had been experiencing, really seemed like paradise.
Howeverー
Me
No, thank you. No matter how happy I might be, I don't want a fake.
I decisively brushed aside the witch's temptations.
I only wanted the real thingーand only if I earned it with my own effort.
Asuka
Oh hoooーBut is that really what you think...?
Shikanosuke
Hmmm? I kinda want it though...
Me
Hey, guys...? You're ruining my cool moment.
Asuka doubted my answer and Shikanosuke seemed to be reluctant to give up his "dream."
Honestly, these guys had no sense of tension.
Witch
Oh my, oh my? ...But I expected you to say that♪ So I'm going to use force, just as planned.
Me
Suddenly, the dangerous aura surrounding the witch swelled.
Asuka, perhaps sensing that she was up against an opponent who demanded full attention, took off her uniform and got ready for battle.
Asuka
Alright, this is it!!! Be careful, both of youー!!
Witch
ーNow, let's begin. Make sure to entertain me, sweethearts♪
